tasks.short: Troubleshoot product problems in designs, materials, or processes.

steps.what: Troubleshoot existing product problems in designs
Assemble lot rows and process history for the case
Judge whether materials or processes caused the fault
Sign the troubleshooting note for this version
File the signed troubleshooting note
outputs: filed copy of signed troubleshooting note v1

tasks.design: A job on {DATA_PLATFORM} builds a problem pack from lot and process rows in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer inspects the part, signs a note in {DOCS}, and a later job files that signed note. A model does not change a safety setting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lot rows, process logs, and the failed part lived in different places, so the cause was rebuilt by hand each time.
tasks.enabler_now: Those logs can be joined on lot and operation without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A new failure mode is not in the history, and someone still has to see the part.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether the design, the material, or the process must change.

ambition.what: Open a troubleshooting note the same day a scrap code repeats.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the cause and the change, not on hunting rows.

reach.task: Collect the failed part and the batch label
reach.learn: Which fields the note requires before the pack is useful

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a machine safety function.

assumptions: The operations record can export lot and scrap rows.
Configure that record before adding a new store.
unknowns: Which system holds the process log.
Whether a local rule requires a second signature on a product note.
research_questions: How often a product problem spans more than one plant.

already_counted.description: Cause judgement on the floor stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate material variances and bottlenecks and resolve them.

steps.what: Investigate material variances and bottlenecks on the line
Join material issues to recorded queue times
Decide how to resolve the operational problems
Sign the variance resolution note
File the signed variance note
outputs: filed copy of signed variance resolution v1

tasks.design: A job joins material issues to queue times already stored in {OPS_SYSTEM} and shows them in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The engineer decides the resolution, signs it in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version. Named people are not timed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variance and queue figures were copied by hand, and a time study of named people needed a separate consent path.
tasks.enabler_now: The line record already stores queue time and scrap by operation.
tasks.still_hard: A bottleneck can sit in a handoff the record does not name.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the fix and whether the line must stop.

ambition.what: Review a repeated material variance the day the queue row appears.

tasks.altitude: The engineer uses the week to remove the bottleneck, not to rebuild the tally.

reach.task: Clear the queue once the resolution is signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S19] requires works-council consent before time studies of presence, behaviour or performance, so queue and scrap figures come from the line record, not from watching a named person.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: Queue time is taken by operation, not by named person.
Configure the existing line record before a new store.
unknowns: Whether the line record timestamps every operation.
Who else must sign a stop-the-line decision.
research_questions: Which variances are noise in the measurement, not a real loss.

already_counted.description: The line investigation stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify process changes that reduce cost, using fabrication knowledge.

steps.what: Identify opportunities in fabrication processes and tooling
Price proposed changes from quantities and the price table
Choose which changes to implement on the product
Sign the improvement change packet
File the signed change packet
outputs: filed copy of signed improvement packet v1

tasks.design: The engineer names the opportunity from the routing in {OPS_SYSTEM}. A job prices it as quantities times the price table in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer signs the packet in {DOCS}, and only that version is filed. A model does not change a safety function.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost and process notes were rebuilt in a sheet for every idea, and the price basis was easy to lose.
tasks.enabler_now: Bill quantities and a maintained price table can be joined without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A cheaper process can still fail a quality standard the table does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides which change is worth a trial, using fabrication knowledge the table does not have.

ambition.what: Price a repeated scrap code against the standard cost before the next routing review.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week choosing the change, not retyping the bill.

reach.task: Trial the signed change on one routing
reach.learn: Which cost line the packet froze

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says a cost estimate is quantities times a price table, and a model may only read supplier quotes that are checked against totals.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a machine safety function.

assumptions: The price table is maintained by procurement and is the only price source.
Configure the existing sheet or record before a new store.
unknowns: Whether a change touches a certified process.
research_questions: How stale the price table is allowed to be.

already_counted.description: Choosing the change stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply continuous improvement methods to quality, reliability, and cost.

steps.what: Apply continuous improvement methods on the line
Tally scrap and queue counts from line records
Choose a method to enhance quality and reliability
Sign the improvement method note
File the signed method note
outputs: filed copy of signed improvement method v1

tasks.design: A dashboard on {DATA_PLATFORM} tallies scrap and queue counts already in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer applies the method on the line, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version. The tally is not a time study of a named person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Improvement notes depended on a fresh tally, and timing a named person raised a consent question.
tasks.enabler_now: Scrap and queue counts are already stored by operation.
tasks.still_hard: The method still has to be tried on the line before it is real.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses the method and whether it is good enough to keep.

ambition.what: Revisit a method when the same scrap code rises for two periods.

tasks.altitude: The engineer uses the week on the method, not on rebuilding the tally.

reach.task: Run the signed method on one shift
reach.learn: Which scrap code the note targets

evidence.claim: Digest [S19] requires works-council consent before time studies of presence, behaviour or performance, so queue and scrap figures come from the line record, not from watching a named person.
Digest [S18] bars a solely automated decision about a worker, so a decision about a person stays with the engineer.

assumptions: Configure the existing line record before a new store.
unknowns: Whether the firm already has a standard improvement cycle.
research_questions: Which scrap codes are too rare to steer a method.

already_counted.description: Applying the method on the line stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

role.altitude: The manufacturing engineer spends the week on cause, design, and the signed decision. Collecting rows and filing a signed note move to a job.
reach: Quality technicians get a field list for the part they collect, instead of a blank request.
Planners wait for the signed note before they move a routing.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no source row.
Release only the version they signed, and leave a safety function to a person.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change note can open a controlled routing update, and the engineer still releases it.
